does: Ends one AI decision request: drops the request count at +0x140 and, when it reaches zero, clears every working array and map that PrepareRequest filled.

evidence.says: empties the helper's working arrays and maps

decrements +0x140; at zero calls +0x3131E70 and zeroes the counts at +0x1CC through +0x2DC, releasing the 0x50-byte entries and their FixedStrings
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on, from 2 places, the same two functions that call PrepareRequest, with the same counts (308 and 14)
